description: What the items of PLAN_GAMES_3.md's Phase 6 say, each written for the game that asked for it

input.natural_language: In a tower game, a right click on a tower sells it, the wheel changes the tower to build, and pointing at a tower says what it sells for

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="sell" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="gold" value="100" type="number" />
  <qg:input action="sell" keys="MouseRight, X" />
  <qg:input action="other-tower" keys="WheelUp, WheelDown, Tab" />
  <qg:prefab name="Tower" tag="tower" sheet="tiles" frame="140" hitbox="18x18" />
  <qg:prefab name="Wall" tag="tower" sheet="tiles" frame="2" hitbox="18x18" />
  <qg:scene name="field" width="320" height="240">
    <q:set name="choice" value="Tower" />
    <qg:cursor player="1" grid="18" sheet="tiles" frame="140" />
    <qg:on-input action="other-tower">
      <q:set name="choice" value="{'Wall' if choice == 'Tower' else 'Tower'}" />
    </qg:on-input>
    <!-- a click builds; a right click sells what is under the cursor -->
    <qg:on-select>
      <q:if condition="{other == null and gold >= 20}">
        <q:set name="gold" value="{gold - 20}" />
        <q:if condition="{choice == 'Tower'}"><qg:spawn prefab="Tower" at="cursor" /></q:if>
        <q:if condition="{choice == 'Wall'}"><qg:spawn prefab="Wall" at="cursor" /></q:if>
      </q:if>
    </qg:on-select>
    <qg:on-select action="sell">
      <q:if condition="{other != null and other.tag == 'tower'}">
        <q:set name="gold" value="{gold + 10}" />
        <qg:destroy target="other" />
      </q:if>
    </qg:on-select>
    <qg:hud position="top-left">
      <qg:counter bind="gold" label="Gold" />
      <qg:text value="{'Right click sells it for 10' if hovered() != null else choice}" />
    </qg:hud>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: A boss fight with its own music

input.natural_language: When the hero comes near the boss, the music changes to a fight theme; when the boss falls, the level's music comes back; each hit sounds a little different

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="boss" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:sound name="level" src="assets/kenney/audio/win.ogg" loop="true" bus="music" />
  <qg:sound name="boss" src="assets/kenney/audio/powerup.ogg" loop="true" bus="music" />
  <qg:sound name="hit1" src="assets/kenney/audio/stomp.ogg" />
  <qg:sound name="hit2" src="assets/kenney/audio/block.ogg" />
  <qg:sound name="hit3" src="assets/kenney/audio/hurt.ogg" />
  <qg:prefab name="Boss" tag="boss" sheet="people" frame="18" hitbox="20x22" health="5">
    <qg:on-damage><qg:play sounds="hit1, hit2, hit3" vary="0.1" /></qg:on-damage>
    <!-- the level's music back, over two seconds -->
    <qg:on-death><qg:music sound="level" fade="2" /></qg:on-death>
  </qg:prefab>
  <qg:scene name="arena" width="320" height="240">
    <qg:music sound="level" />
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="120" hitbox="14x14"
                  attack-action="jump" attack-reach="16">
      <qg:on-hit with="boss"><qg:damage target="other" amount="1" /></qg:on-hit>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:instance prefab="Boss" name="boss" x="260" y="120" />
    <!-- the fight's theme, once, as the hero comes near -->
    <qg:when condition="{distance(hero, boss) < 120}">
      <qg:music sound="boss" fade="0.5" />
    </qg:when>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

input.natural_language: In a level wider than the screen, a cannon off to the right booms each time it fires, and the boom is heard from its side, softer while it is far

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="cannon" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:sound name="boom" src="assets/kenney/audio/stomp.ogg" />
  <qg:sound name="ping" src="assets/kenney/audio/coin.ogg" />
  <qg:prefab name="Ball" tag="ball" sheet="tiles" frame="151" hitbox="10x10" ai="fly" heading="left" speed="120" />
  <!-- a thing's own sounds come from where it is: the cannon's boom, from the right -->
  <qg:prefab name="Cannon" tag="cannon" sheet="tiles" frame="140" hitbox="18x18" ai="turret" targets="hero"
             range="600" fire-prefab="Ball" fire-every="120" fire-sound="boom" />
  <qg:scene name="long" width="320" height="180">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="platformer" sheet="people" frame="0" x="40" y="140" hitbox="14x20">
      <!-- and a sound played from a thing: the ball, where it hit -->
      <qg:on-collision with="ball"><qg:play sound="ping" at="other" /><qg:destroy target="other" /></qg:on-collision>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:instance prefab="Cannon" name="cannon" x="900" y="140" />
    <qg:camera follow="hero" bounds="none" />
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>
